messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org=NimbusCorp (org_9876) — sustained QPS ~500% above baseline for 3m, 5xx rate 12%. Auto-policy ran a soft per-org throttle. Paging oncall SRE.
Becca (oncall): I'm on it. @Dan can you confirm if the soft throttle applied and what's customer-visible right now?
Dan (sre): I see the auto-policy logged. Soft throttle in place but ingress still high; 429s increasing from org_9876. 5xxs trending up intermittently. Recommend hard cap to protect shared capacity.
Maya (eng): dropping QPS will increase 429s but should reduce platform degradation. Any preference on target qps?
Liz (customer-success): I've pinged Nimbus support channel. They're reporting client-side timeouts and retries. They want ETA and whether we'll throttle at org or route level.
Becca (oncall): Plan: apply emergency per-org hard cap qps=35 (temporary), enable 2% sampling for debugging, create rollback at +30m. Dan, pls execute and post commands here.
Dan (sre):
```
# apply emergency per-org throttle
redwoodctl org set-quota --org 9876 --qps 35 --type emergency --reason "auto-surge-mitigation 2003007890"
redwoodctl sampling enable --org 9876 --ratio 0.02
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Job id j-9f3a. Applying policy now...
deploy-bot: Policy applied: org=9876 qps=35 (emergency). Effective immediately. Console: https://console.redwood.example/policies/j-9f3a
Becca (oncall): Confirmed change in console. Monitoring dashboards. :thumbsup:
Dan (sre): Quick metrics: ingress dropped ~60% within 90s, 5xxs trending down. 429s as expected. Sampling output being written to s3://incidents/nimbus/2003007890/ for trace collection.
ops-bot: Created incident INC-5482 and linked this thread.
Liz (customer-success): Nimbus support channel updated. They're preparing a short customer notice. Asking if we can do staged bursts if needed.
Ken (infra): We can allow a short burst window to avoid client churn — suggest token-bucket burst=80 for 10s windows while keeping steady qps=35. Approve?
Becca (oncall): Approve. Dan, please apply burst setting.
Dan (sre):
```
redwoodctl org set-quota --org 9876 --qps 35 --burst 80 --reason "safe-burst 2003007890"
```

deploy-bot: Burst updated: burst=80 applied for org=9876.
Maya (eng): Traces show ~10% of requests hitting a slow backend; captured samples look useful. Opening internal ticket to investigate root cause.
Becca (oncall): Setting reminder for 30m to re-evaluate. Follow-ups: Dan=postmortem/root-cause, Maya=perf traces, Liz=customer comms. If errors stable, we'll lift throttle gradually.
ops-bot: Reminder created for +30m and linked to INC-5482.
--- 28 minutes later ---
Dan (sre): +28m check: 5xx <1%, p50/p95 latency stable, ingress ~20% of peak. Recommend rolling back to baseline qps=500 (org default) with canary ramp.
Becca (oncall): Proceed with canary rollback (1/3 -> 2/3 -> full). Dan, please run rollback command.
Dan (sre):
```
redwoodctl org set-quota --org 9876 --qps 500 --reason "rollback post-mitigation 2003007890"
```

deploy-bot: Quota updated to qps=500. Canary rollout started (step 1/3).
Liz (customer-success): Nimbus confirms they see improvement and appreciate the quick action.
Becca (oncall): :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated. Final notes: follow-up ticket INC-5482 owns postmortem, Dan is postmortem owner. Will include traffic patterns, kernel throttling logs, and suggested long-term controls (adaptive per-org burst profiles). Closing thread after docs posted.
